procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of incident were: wind 5 knots and choppy sea.
At 1 1/2 minutes before the start, IRL 216111 and IND 222138 were sailing on a close-hauled starboard tack, approaching the starting line at the race committee end.
IRL 216111 was clear ahead of IND 222138 and 0,5 meters to leeward of IND 222138.
There were two boats in close proximity to leeward of IRL 216111.
1 minute before the starting of IRL 216111 was 0,5 meters from the portside of RC vessel.
IND 222138 established 1/4 windward overlap with IRL 216111 and changed course by bearing away toward IRL 216111.
IND 222138 was then on convergent course aiming to the starboard aft quarter of IRL 216111.
IND 222138 bow made contact with the starboard aft quarter of IRL 216111.
conclusions: IND 222138 to windward failed to keep clear of IRL 216111 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
IND 222138 did not avoid contact with IRL 216111 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for IRL 216111 the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with IND 222138 when it became clear that IND 222138 was not keeping clear. IRL 216111 did not break RRS 14(a).
decision: IND 222138 is DSQ in race Q2.
